activity.notes: Kusunoki Masashige served Emperor Go-Daigo as a military commander from the emperor's first anti-Kamakura rising in 1331 through the overthrow of the shogunate, the Kenmu Restoration, and his death fighting for Go-Daigo in 1336. ATLAS binds him to Japan, while the Kenmu Restoration is treated as a government/regime context rather than incorrectly promoted to a separate Polity.

sources.title: Statue of Kusunoki Masashige — Japan Ministry of the Environment
sources.citation_text: Japan's Ministry of the Environment identifies Kusunoki Masashige as a 1294–1336 warrior whose strategic leadership helped Emperor Go-Daigo overthrow the shogunate and notes Go-Daigo's failed first attempt in 1331 and Kusunoki's later death in battle.
